result: I made `explainers/float-sum/explanation.md`, along with `model.md` and `model.yaml` to hold the facts and numbers it relies on. I chose prose because the cause is one short chain: round each number to binary, add, round once more. A worked table and one small number-line sketch carry the numbers, so a diagram or interactive page would add little. I checked the binary arithmetic by hand, but I couldn't run `explainer check` because I have no shell here.
